leadText: Tsuguo Mogami (Japanese: 最上嗣生 Mogami Tsuguo) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Tsuguo Mogami (Japanese: 最上嗣生 Mogami Tsuguo) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Mogami was born on January 8, 1980, in , . He began to provide voices for the in . He has since provided the voices of several and characters of the day. His most notable roles are Driftveil City Gym Leader Clay and Team Flare scientist Xerosic.
